title: Angara proposes inter-agency task force after Cotabato school shooting

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Education Secretary Sonny Angara has proposed establishing a Joint School Safety Task Force alongside the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) to conduct site-specific security audits across public schools nationwide. The proposal comes in response to a directive from President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
